name: 北森招聘主流程
description_zh: 北森招聘主流程管理工具。覆盖职位搜索与详情、AI 推荐人才、候选人申请列表与详情、人才库推荐候选人搜索，以及异步任务管理与轮询。一站式管理职位与候选人。
description_en: Main-process recruitment management for Beisen. Covers job search & details, AI-recommended candidates, candidate application lists & details, talent pool candidate search, and async task management & polling. One-stop management of jobs and candidates.
